preconditions.description: The number of vertices V is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The adjacency list contains exactly V entries, one for each vertex.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= v < V for neighbors in adj for v in neighbors)
preconditions.description: All edge destinations in the adjacency list are valid vertex indices between 0 and V-1.

preconditions.expression: all(v not in neighbors for i, neighbors in enumerate(adj) for v in [i])

postconditions.description: The returned list of safe nodes is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= node < V for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every node in the returned list is a valid vertex index.
The returned list contains no duplicate nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(all(any(target in return_value for target in adj[node]) or len(adj[node]) == 0 for node in return_value), True)
postconditions.description: Every node in the returned list is a safe node: either it is terminal (no outgoing edges) or all its outgoing edges lead to other safe nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(not (len(adj[node]) == 0 or all(any(target in return_value for target in adj[node]) or len(adj[node]) == 0 for node in [node])) for node in range(V) if node not in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every node not in the returned list is not a safe node: it is either part of a cycle or leads to a cycle, meaning not all paths from it lead to a terminal node.
